# ATLAS LATTICE — OCTOBER 30, 2026 THREE-SWEEP CONVERGENCE INDEX
**Provenance:** DeepSeek report supplied by author; Gemini reports (English and Chinese) supplied by author; independent assistant sweep with issuer and peer-reviewed checks. **Status:** Working evidence map, not model validation. No existing code, baseline, or speculative canon overwritten.

## Research evidence classification
**E1** peer-reviewed empirical experiment; **E2** company/institution announcements or procurement statements; **E3** theoretical paper or preprint; **E4** unverified secondhand claim; **E5** speculative research and fiction implication. These codes describe evidence *type*, not correctness.

## Cross-sweep junctions

## Source-level correction flags
1. **DOE Genesis:** $159m aggregate 12 projects, not $159m entirely to CFS.
2. **Willow:** 40-fold error reduction is not 40-fold reduction in electricity/cost; keep acceptance and resource-distillation accounting separate.
3. **FLiBe:** ~0.3 kcal/mol molecular fragment accuracy vs ~110 kcal/mol whole-system binding reconstruction discrepancy; not extraction efficiency/TBR data.
4. **IBM:** 99% state transfer but ~94.75% remote CZ gate fidelity; not fault-tolerant quantum networking at scale.
5. **ECOFERM launch:** NIZO publication dated **Sep 30**, not Oct 1.
6. **HydraOS:** announced **Sep 14**, not October.
7. **CFS >10,000 km:** Fujikura/CFS issuer agreement announced **Sep 30**, not Oct 8.
8. **Guizhou:** actual integrated design announced Oct 28; 33.1bn yuan is investment plan, not return.
9. **Beyond Q baseline:** Reactor B=**1.13 GW D-T fusion**; Reactor A=**hypothetical 20 MW primary D-D**; never silently substitute older 525 MW configuration.
10. **No evidence laundering:** multiple AI summaries repeating the same underlying press release are **not independent experimental validations**.

## Immediate next technical actions
- **P0:** Add source registry/dated quantitative fields; verified vs derived vs proposed separated; retain original links.
- **P1:** G3 FLiBe chemistry-to-inventory adapter with uncertainty and no silent measured yield.
- **P1:** Q0–Q3 modularity/QEC tradeoff study with thermal and electrical ledgers.
- **P1:** Nightmare Lab faults with physics-surrogate disagreement and independent safety-case review.
- **P1:** Guizhou/Xingfa PG sulfur/iron material mass flows and realistic baseline alternatives.
- **P2:** ECOFERM continuous protein production and HydraOS water recovery scenario comparisons.
- **P2:** Cross-cutting fiction receipt updates after quantitative research passes.
**Editorial invariant:** real-world industrial progress motivates simulations; simulations and stories do not become validated engineering conclusions merely because the news converges.

# STARS physics appendix — p-11B H-mode, muon hypothesis and centrifugal shear
**As of 2026-10-30; evidence-layer separation mandatory.** Summary audit: [DeepSeek register](https://github.com/atlaslattice/open-regenerative-compute-standard/blob/main/docs/fiction/iron_empire/DEEPSEEK_RESEARCH_CONVERGENCE_EVIDENCE_AUDIT_v0_1_2026-10-30.md).
## Empirical
The EXL-50U publication describes H-mode operation in boron-containing plasma. This establishes a confinement-regime observation; it does not establish net p-11B electrical output, or validate acoustic pretreatment. Source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13343428/
DeepSeek also reports >10^8 p-11B reactions/s and beam-target yield enhancement 1.48x/1.75x, but those particular studies were **not independently verified in our source audit**. Keep separate from EXL-50U H-mode.
## Theory
2026 Physical Review C muon-catalysis work calculates increased low-energy p-11B reaction cross sections: https://journals.aps.org/prc/accepted/10.1103/2p5j-2m53 . An increased cross section is **not** proof of favorable muon-production, fuel, capture, plasma heating or whole-plant energy balance.
A 2026 centrifugal-shear non-equilibrium proposal has been published as a technical disclosure: https://www.tdcommons.org/dpubs_series/11795/ . Review assumptions, Rider comparison, collisions, magnet/field conditions and stability before attaching it to PRISM. A theoretical paper is not a validated operating machine.
## Existing experimental gate protection
Preserve sham-controlled acoustic/laser success probability, shot timing, jitter and target stability independently from fusion energy yield. Do not infer an acoustic effect from H-mode or muon theory.
Model routing: [STARS 2.2 centrifugal white paper](https://github.com/atlaslattice/open-regenerative-compute-standard/blob/main/research/stars_2_0/whitepapers/STARS_2_2_CENTRIFUGAL_HYBRID_525MW_SCALING_WHITEPAPER_2026-10-29.md) is *historical* and must not override the later **1.13 GW B / 20 MW A** reference used in the dual-reactor fuel cycle.

# Beyond Q — Gemini convergence audit: FLiBe chemistry and fusion engineering
**2026-10-30 | Evidence note, no parameter changes**
## Primary breakthrough
Das et al., *Quantum Computations on Fusion Blanket Molten Salts*, preprint posted 2026-06-29, https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30402 , used hybrid quantum-classical calculations and IBM hardware to study tritium-containing FLiBe clusters. Quantum fragment energies agreed with high-accuracy benchmarks at mean absolute deviation ~0.3 kcal/mol across nine configurations. **Full-system reconstruction exposed ~110 kcal/mol average tritium-binding-energy discrepancy.** These are NOT accurate validated bulk extraction predictions: fragment construction/long-range electrostatics remain serious limitations. Oak Ridge press report https://www.ornl.gov/news/oak-ridge-national-lab-cleveland-clinic-and-ibm-achieve-first-known-computations-fusion/
### G3 research interpretation
- Treat as empirical computational demonstration of a **method**, not experimental tritium recovery, measured diffusion coefficient, speciation map, residence time, permeation or extraction efficiency.
- Add potential future chemistry input layer: composition, temperature, ionic configurations, free energies, equilibrium constants and uncertainty (not computed here).
- Require thermodynamic and transport validation before coupling to FLiBe extraction ODEs, time-dependent inventory, permeation barriers, throughput or tritium breeding ratio.
- Preserve existing baseline Reactor B **1.13 GW D-T fusion** and Reactor A **hypothetical 20 MW primary D-D**. No automatic recalibration.
## Verified industry signals
Proxima Fusion/Kyoto Fusioneering MOU for gyrotron heating and fuel-cycle technologies (2026-10-28), https://www.proximafusion.com/press-news/proxima-fusion-kyoto-fusioneering-mou .
Proxima Fusion/Fujikura MOU to *study* German HTS production, including ~20,000 km anticipated Alpha and ~40,000 km planned Stellaris demand, https://www.proximafusion.com/press-news/proxima-fusion-fujikura-hts-tape-germany .
Kyoto Fusioneering/Focused Energy laser-fusion balance-of-plant engineering MOU, https://kyotofusioneering.com/en/news/2026/10/29/4977 .
MoU ≠ purchase order, commissioned factory, or validated fusion device.
CFS SPARC digital twin DOE Genesis Phase II selection, https://cfs.energy/news-and-media/commonwealth-fusion-systems-to-lead-ai-enabled-digital-twin-fusion-project-in-second-phase-of-genesis-mission/ . DOE **$159M across 12 Phase II awards**, not a $159M CFS award, https://stage.energy.gov/articles/energy-department-announces-new-genesis-mission-awards-advance-super-intelligence-science .
CFS $85M semiconductor/power electronics **letter of intent for proposed award** (Oct 22), https://www.cfs.energy/news-and-media/commonwealth-fusion-systems-signs-85-million-letter-of-intent-with-the-u.s.-department-of-commerce .
CFS/Fujikura >10,000 km HTS announcement was September 30, 2026, not October 8.
## Recommended experimental model actions
1. Add G3 chemistry-benchmark backlog: total binding energies, classical references, quantum-fragment errors, embedding bias, sample environments.
2. Record procurement state machine: proposed -> MOU -> order/award -> delivered -> tested -> commissioned; never infer downstream readiness.
3. Distinguish fusion thermal, plant net electric, auxiliary RF loads and upstream electricity/material costs.
4. Run sensitivity analysis only once quantities can be sourced; no inferred performance validation.

# Nightmare Lab — Saltworks process twins and adversarial independence
**2026-10-30 · R&D addendum, not deployed safety controls.**
Saltworks primary release https://www.saltworkstech.com/news/hydraos-intelligent-operating-system-for-water-and-lithium-processing-plants/ :
HydraSim simulator, HydraTwin **offline** digital twin, HydraVE document-grounded assistant, RoboSense automated ion-specific sensing. The release explicitly characterizes HydraTwin as offline, not a proven autonomous real-time closed-loop plant controller. Ion-by-ion coverage and measurement error bars require datasheets/field verification. Source does not establish particular membrane foul rates or recovery economics.
Proposed Nightmare Lab wrapper: frozen evidence logs, sensor-drift/fouling injection, independent fault model, operator-visible uncertainty, hard interlocks, physical relief valves and human adjudication. Keep normal optimizer separate from adversarial validator; adversarial digital twin itself cannot certify industrial safety. Test contradictions against calibration data and out-of-distribution conditions before safety claims.
Link existing protocol https://github.com/atlaslattice/open-regenerative-compute-standard/blob/main/research/beyond_q/safety/BQ_NIGHTMARE_LAB_PROTOCOL_v0_1.md .

# Beyond Q Nightmare Lab — Physics-grounded digital twin evidence watch
**2026-10-30; risk-engineering concept, not certified safety model.**
Imperial College London and AMPERA announced a **£7m partnership Oct 27** to develop NeuralTwin, integrating high-fidelity numerical physics and faster AI surrogate models for advanced energy systems. Source: https://www.imperial.ac.uk/news/articles/2026/imperial-and-ampera-join-forces-to-develop-digital-twin-platform-for-advanced-nuclear-energy-systems/ .
CFS SPARC Genesis digital-twin project is another reference; previous October 30 appendix clarifies DOE **$159m covers 12 Phase II projects, not CFS alone**: https://github.com/atlaslattice/open-regenerative-compute-standard/blob/main/research/stars_2_0/extensions/beyond_q/tritium_self_sufficiency_audit_v1/APPENDIX_2026_10_30_GEMINI_FLIBE_QUANTUM_CHEMISTRY_FUSION_SUPPLY_WATCH.md .
**Nightmare Lab addendum requirements:** physics vs surrogate disagreement; in-distribution vs outside-domain tags; sensor drift; common-cause faults; emergency-state latency; thermal/tritium failure cascades; human override, independent reviewers and stop-safe controls. Simulation **cannot certify** physical safety without experimental validation, safety case and independent review. Connect with existing [protocol](https://github.com/atlaslattice/open-regenerative-compute-standard/blob/main/research/beyond_q/safety/BQ_NIGHTMARE_LAB_PROTOCOL_v0_1.md) and [discussion notes](https://github.com/atlaslattice/open-regenerative-compute-standard/blob/main/research/beyond_q/safety/BQ_HR_E145_MERITOCRACY_NIGHTMARE_LAB_DISCUSSION_NOTES_2026-10-29.md).
**Suggested tests:** paired baseline and falsification suite, explicit failure injection, frozen sensor feeds, adversarial alarm delay, shared faulty training data, surrogate failure at extreme values, and auditable human disposition.

# ATLAS LATTICE — DeepSeek Research Convergence Watch
## Fusion / Isotopes / Quantum / Brines / Phosphogypsum / Iron Empire
**Research note v0.1 — 2026-10-30**
**Status:** Evidence-graded incoming external-AI report, partially verified against public primary sources. **Not a validation of any ORCS/Beyond Q/STARS model predictions, not a canon lock.**
**Source:** DeepSeek text supplied by author on 2026-10-30 (95-line attached paste); claims below are attributed to it unless independently verified.

## Executive interpretation
Several developments independently substantiate that real organizations are committing resources to **hardware procurement, isotope sourcing, advanced plasma research, and industrial resource recovery**. They reinforce the *questions* asked by Atlas Lattice—system-level input self-sufficiency, supply security, opportunity cost and circular production—but do not prove that its dual D-D/D-T architecture, proton–boron variants or circular-material economics achieve their simulated targets.

## Evidence register

| Phosphogypsum | Wuhuan four projects >9Mt PG; Hubei 2Mt→0.8Mt acid, 0.8Mt clinker; recovery percentages | **DEEPSEEK-REPORTED; project totals and efficiencies NOT independently verified here** | Seek issuer/EPC primary documentation before elevating figures |

## Critical research separations
1. **Projected ARC values:** Existing Beyond Q v1.1 comparison must preserve **Reactor B = 1.13 GW D-T fusion power** and **Reactor A = hypothetical 20 MW primary D-D reference**. Do not substitute older 525 MW ARC architecture, or conflate 400 MW planned *net electric* with fusion thermal power. The CFS announcements do not validate our own CAPEX or fuel-cycle economics.
2. **He-3 supply alternatives:** Include Topaz extraction as a *contingent* scenario alongside inventory/recycling, other terrestrial production, possible D-D coproduct and alternative quantum modalities. Require volume and concentration, separation efficiency, energy/cost, impurities, operational risk, contracting and actual delivered isotope availability. **Low ppb concentration alone does not show commercial supply.**
3. **Muon-enhanced p-11B:** Cross-section alone is an insufficient figure of merit. Separate catalyst inventory, muon source energy/cost, capture efficiency, sticking/loss, cycling count, fuel-plasma conditions, alpha energy capture, bremsstrahlung and total wall-plug balance.
4. **Acoustic hypothesis:** EXL-50U H-mode and muon theory do **not** demonstrate that mechanical acoustic pretreatment increases fusion yield. Preserve sham-controlled shot-success/jitter/target conditioning metrics as separate research gates; don't claim demonstrated effects without controls.
5. **Centrifugal shear:** Defensive publication may be prior art or simulation claim, but must undergo parameter extraction, numerical reproducibility, boundary conditions, stability, radiation losses and feasibility audit before model integration.
6. **PG acid and brines:** Compare mass balance, real operating recovery and substitution value, not announced nameplate outputs. A planned investment is evidence of commercial interest, not proven operating margin or overall societal ROI.
7. **Iron Empire narrative connection:** The real-world analogy of a machine dependent on scarce purchased inputs works well for imperial nutrition and isotope dependence. The story may explore why extraction/conquest becomes institutionally entrenched, **not** presume supply scarcity causes conquest or that economic cooperation guarantees peace.
